derivation: from G1909 (ἐπί) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565 (ἐκεῖνος);
def: upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of

occurrences.text: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
